from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
root=Path("vitrina/train")
print(sorted(p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:6])
paths=sorted(p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower()==".png")
classes=sorted({p.parent.name for p in paths})
to_idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(classes)}
imgs=[]; labels=[];bad=[]
counts={c:0 for c in classes}
for p in paths:
    try:
        z=np.array(Image.open(p).convert("L"))
    except Exception:
        bad.append(p.name);continue
    imgs.append(z);labels.append(to_idx[p.parent.name]);counts[p.parent.name]+=1
X=np.stack(imgs);y=np.array(labels)
print(X.shape,classes,counts,bad)
expect: Массив читаемыхPNG(n,32,32), алфавитныеclasses иy, counts; один битыйPNG вbad, uppercasePNG включён,мусор исключён.
